name: list_feeds
description: List all available RaceHooks data feeds, including which subscription tier each feed requires. The special 'events.race' feed is a synthetic feed that emits structured events (overtakes, pit stops, safety cars, etc.) derived from multiple raw feeds.

name: list_webhooks
description: List all webhook subscriptions for the authenticated RaceHooks account.

name: get_webhook
description: Get a single webhook subscription by ID.

name: create_webhook
description: Register a new webhook subscription. Returns the webhook and the HMAC signing secret (shown once — store it immediately).

arguments.name: feedId
arguments.desc: Feed ID from list_feeds. Use 'events.race' for structured race events.

arguments.name: webhookUrl
arguments.desc: Public HTTPS URL to deliver payloads to.

name: update_webhook
description: Update an existing webhook subscription. Use active: false to pause delivery, active: true to resume. Can also update the endpoint URL, HTTP method, or filters without deleting and recreating the webhook.

name: delete_webhook
description: Permanently delete a webhook subscription.

name: test_webhook
description: Send a test payload to a webhook endpoint immediately. Useful for verifying your server is reachable and your HMAC verification code is correct.

name: get_webhook_logs
description: Retrieve recent delivery logs for a webhook — shows status codes, retry counts, and payload excerpts.

name: get_webhook_secret
description: Retrieve the current HMAC signing secret for a webhook.

name: rotate_webhook_secret
description: Rotate the HMAC signing secret for a webhook. The old secret is invalidated immediately — update your server before calling this. The new secret is shown once.

name: get_live_session
description: Get the current live session state: flag status, lap number, driver positions, intervals, tyre compounds, and recent race control messages. Returns an empty/inactive context when no session is live. Live per-driver timing requires Developer or higher; Free receives the latest milestone classification (end of a qualifying segment or the final result) instead.

name: list_events
description: List events (race weekends) for the current or a specific season, including session schedules and status.

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: Season year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to current season.

arguments.name: upcoming
arguments.desc: true = only return events that haven't started yet

name: get_subscription
description: Get the current subscription tier, plan limits (webhooks, deliveries, HMAC, analytics enrichment), and live usage snapshot for this account.

name: get_usage
description: Get delivery usage summary for the current period: total deliveries, failures, tier, and remaining monthly delivery bucket.

name: get_usage_by_feed
description: Get webhook delivery counts broken down by feed for the current period. Useful for identifying which feeds are driving delivery volume.

name: get_usage_latency
description: Get webhook delivery latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) broken down by feed for the current period.

name: get_usage_hourly
description: Get webhook delivery volume broken down by hour for the last 24 hours. Useful for identifying traffic spikes.

name: get_usage_history
description: Get historical delivery counts and failure rates over past periods.

name: get_billing_plan
description: Get the detailed billing plan including tier, subscription period end date, limits, and current usage.

name: list_replay_sessions
description: List recorded sessions that have archived data and can be replayed. Only completed sessions with archive paths are returned. Self-serve tiers (Free and Developer) list the current season only, plus the curated demo session; the full historical archive is on Custom. `restrictedToSeason` in the response reports the applied limit.

name: get_demo_session
description: Get the curated demo session to replay (the canonical ID of a guaranteed-real event).

name: get_replay_quota
description: Get the replay delivery quota for this account: distinct-session lifetime slots for your tier.

name: prepare_replay
description: Prepare a session for recorded playback, generating its playback artifact if not already cached. Check readiness with get_replay_status.

arguments.name: sessionId
arguments.desc: Session ID from list_replay_sessions or get_demo_session.

name: get_replay_status
description: Check whether a session's playback artifact is ready to stream.

arguments.name: sessionId
arguments.desc: Session ID from list_replay_sessions or get_demo_session.

name: list_drivers
description: List drivers. Available on every plan; page size is capped at 25 on Free and 100 on paid plans.

name: get_driver
description: Get a driver profile with career statistics (wins, podiums, poles, championships). Available on every plan.

name: get_driver_results
description: Get race-by-race results for a driver. Available on every plan; timing fields (gap, finish time) are only returned on Developer and above.

arguments.name: season
arguments.desc: Filter to a specific season year, e.g. 2026.

name: get_driver_standings
description: Get championship standings history for a driver across seasons. Available on every plan.

arguments.name: season
arguments.desc: Filter to a specific season year.

name: list_constructors
description: List constructors. Available on every plan.

name: get_constructor
description: Get a constructor profile including its lineage history (predecessor and successor teams). Available on every plan.

name: get_constructor_results
description: Get race-by-race results for a constructor. Available on every plan; timing fields (gap, finish time) are only returned on Developer and above.

name: get_constructor_standings
description: Get championship standings history for a constructor across seasons. Available on every plan.

name: list_circuits
description: List all F1 circuits with location and coordinates. Available on every plan.

name: get_circuit
description: Get circuit details and analytics (compound priors, historical pace data). Available on every plan.

name: list_seasons
description: List all available F1 seasons with race counts. Available on every plan.

name: get_season_standings
description: Get final driver and constructor championship standings for a season. Available on every plan.

name: get_season_races
description: List all races in a season with circuit, date, and data quality tier. Available on every plan.

name: get_race
description: Get race details with full results and qualifying grid. Available on every plan; timing fields (gaps, fastest lap, finish time, Q1/Q2/Q3 times) are only returned on Developer and above.

name: get_race_qualifying
description: Get qualifying results for a race. Available on every plan; Q1/Q2/Q3 times are only returned on Developer and above.

name: get_race_pitstops
description: Get all pit stop records for a race (driver, stop number, lap, duration). Available on every plan.

name: get_race_tyres
description: Get tyre stint records for a race (driver, stint number, lap range, compound, tyre age). Available on every plan.

name: get_race_weather
description: Get lap-by-lap weather data for a race. Available on every plan.

name: get_race_laps
description: Get per-lap times and positions for a race. Requires Developer or higher. Optionally filter to a single driver with driverId.

arguments.name: driverId
arguments.desc: Filter to a specific driver, e.g. 'max_verstappen'.

name: get_race_summary
description: Get the post-race analytics status and aggregate telemetry metrics for a race. Status is available on every plan; the aggregate metrics are only returned on Developer and above.

name: get_race_telemetry_laps
description: Get per-lap telemetry metrics (speed, throttle, brake, DRS, aggression) from telemetry data. Requires Developer or higher. Optional driverId to filter to one driver.

name: get_race_telemetry_stints
description: Get per-stint telemetry metrics and degradation slopes. Requires a Custom plan (not included in Developer).

name: get_race_telemetry_aggression
description: Get driver aggression index rankings for a race. Requires a Custom plan (not included in Developer).

name: get_session_analytics
description: Get per-lap ML analytics snapshot for a session (pit probability, SC probability, tyre health, LTOE, win probability). Requires Developer or higher.

name: get_event_pace
description: Get practice and qualifying pace summary per driver for an event. Requires Developer or higher.

name: list_insight_races
description: List races that have a completed post-race analytics pipeline — i.e. races where get_race_insights will return data. Available on every plan.

arguments.name: season
arguments.desc: Filter to a specific season year.

name: get_race_insights
description: Get the full post-race ML analytics bundle for a race. Includes per-driver per-lap outputs: pit stop probability, safety car probability, overtake probability, undercut probability, tyre health, cliff risk and lap prediction, fuel-corrected lap time (LTOE), win probability, expected championship points. Also includes pit stops, tyre stints, lap times, and safety-car lap list. Output depends on plan: Free receives the descriptive data plus tyre state only (compound, tyre life, tyre health); the strategic predictions require Developer or higher.

name: get_model_meta
description: Get the public model manifest for each RaceHooks predictive model: what it predicts, its model family, a qualitative calibration tier, when it was last trained, and a changelog. Raw evaluation metrics are not exposed. Available on every plan.

name: get_telemetry_laps
description: Get per-lap telemetry aggregates (avg/max speed, throttle, brake, DRS, aggression index). Returns all drivers by default. Filter with driverId or lapNumber. Requires Developer or higher.

arguments.name: lapNumber
arguments.desc: Filter to a specific lap number.

name: get_telemetry_driver_laps
description: Get per-lap telemetry for a single driver across all laps of a race. Requires Developer or higher.

name: get_telemetry_lap_comparison
description: Get all drivers' telemetry for a single lap — useful for side-by-side lap comparisons. Requires Developer or higher.

name: get_telemetry_race_summary
description: Get race-level telemetry summary: max speed, fastest driver, average throttle/brake percentages, top aggression driver. Requires Developer or higher.

name: get_fantasy_pit_times
description: Get the pit-stop time leaderboard for a session: stationary time (seconds stopped in the box) per stop, with driver code and team. Requires Developer or higher.

arguments.name: sessionId
arguments.desc: Session ID from list_events (e.g. a race session).

name: get_fantasy_scores
description: Get estimated F1 Fantasy points per driver for a completed race. Includes full scoring breakdown: race position points, qualifying points, Q2/Q3 bonuses, positions gained, fastest lap, beat-teammate bonuses, and DNF penalty. Requires Developer or higher.
